# Borrowing limits by card class

Every card belongs to exactly one class, and the class fixes how many items may
be on loan at once and for how long.

| Class | Items on loan | Loan period |
|---|---|---|
| Adult resident | 40 | 21 days |
| Adult non-resident | 10 | 21 days |
| Child | 25 | 28 days |
| Institutional | 100 | 42 days |
| Temporary visitor | 3 | 7 days |

Within any class, no more than 6 items may be from the audiovisual collection
and no more than 2 may be from the seven-day high-demand collection.

A card class is set when the card is issued and changed only at a service desk
on production of proof. A child card converts to adult resident automatically on
the holder's sixteenth birthday, and the higher limit takes effect overnight.

Institutional cards are issued to schools and care homes, are held by a named
responsible officer, and are reviewed every 12 months.
